limits.conditions: recommended operating maximum, which is also the absolute maximum
limits.note: ESP32 Series Datasheet v5.3, Table 5-2 Recommended Power Supply Characteristics (p. 51): VDDA, VDD3P3_RTC, VDD3P3, VDD_SDIO (3.3 V mode) and VDD3P3_CPU 3.6 V max; Table 5-1 Absolute Maximum Ratings (p. 51): allowed input voltage 3.6 V max. The module agrees: ESP32-WROOM-32 datasheet v3.8, Table 13 Recommended Operating Conditions (p. 26), VDD33 3.0 to 3.6 V, and Table 12 (p. 26) 3.6 V absolute maximum. Chip and module, not board: the board's 3V3 pin is the module's 3V3 supply.

limits.conditions: board limit (regulator varies)
limits.note: Two readings: the DOIT schematic names U1 NCP1117, which allows 20 V input (onsemi NCP1117/D Rev. 28, Maximum Ratings p. 2, https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/41a2561fccbd9856f05aa9b1636142b5.pdf), but retail DOIT-style boards commonly carry an AMS1117-3.3, 15 V absolute maximum input (AMS1117 datasheet p. 2, the cited source), and the schematic gives the VIN capacitor C1 (10 uF) no voltage rating. The lower, 15 V, is used.

typical.note: chip, not board. Table 5-4 (p. 52): Wi-Fi receive 802.11b/g/n 95 ~ 100 mA typ (upper end taken), 3.3 V, 25 C. With the radio off, Modem-sleep at 240 MHz dual-core is 30 ~ 68 mA (Table 4-2, p. 30). Excludes the USB-UART bridge and LEDs (see unaccounted).

peak.note: Wi-Fi transmit 802.11b, DSSS 1 Mbps, POUT = +19.5 dBm: 240 mA typ, Table 5-4 (p. 52), 3.3 V, 25 C, measured at 50 % duty cycle; chip, not board.

minVolts.note: ESP32-WROOM-32 module, Table 13 Recommended Operating Conditions (p. 26): VDD33 min 3.0 V. The module, not the board.

vf.note: The DOIT schematic names D1 "SS14" (VCCUSB to VIN) with no maker; Vishay SS14 as the representative part. Maximum instantaneous forward voltage 0.50 V at IF = 1.0 A, 25 C, pulse test (Electrical Characteristics, p. 2). At the board's 0.1 to 0.3 A the typical drop is lower (Fig. 3, p. 3), so this overstates the loss.

vout.note: onsemi NCP1117 (U1 on the DOIT schematic, output net VDD3V3, so the fixed 3.3 V version). Electrical Characteristics (p. 3): 3.3 V typ (3.267 to 3.333 V at Vin = 5.3 V, Iout = 10 mA, 25 C). Distributor (LCSC) copy of onsemi NCP1117/D Rev. 28.

dropout.note: Electrical Characteristics (p. 3): dropout typ 1.01 V at Iout = 500 mA (0.95 V at 100 mA, 1.07 V at 800 mA; max 1.15 V at 500 mA), measured at Vout - 100 mV. 500 mA covers the board's Wi-Fi transmit peak.

ioutMax.note: Output current limit min 1000 mA (Vin - Vout = 5 V, 25 C), Electrical Characteristics p. 3; p. 1 rates the series for "in excess of 1.0 A".

iq.note: Quiescent current, 3.3 V version, typ 6.0 mA (max 10 mA) at Vin = 15 V, Electrical Characteristics continued, p. 4.

outputResistance.note: Linear approximation at the default drive strength 2 (~20 mA; the datasheet notes on the pin list give 0: ~5, 1: ~10, 2: ~20, 3: ~40 mA, default 2). Table 5-3 (p. 52) at the maximum strength: high (3.3 - 2.64 V) / 40 mA = 16.5 ohm, low 0.495 V / 28 mA = 17.7 ohm, about 17 ohm; halving the strength roughly doubles it, about 34 ohm. A pin set to strength 3 is nearer 17 ohm. Chip, not board.

pullup.note: chip, not board. Table 5-3 (p. 52) RPU typ 45 kohm, 3.3 V, 25 C.

pulldown.note: chip, not board. Table 5-3 (p. 52) RPD typ 45 kohm, 3.3 V, 25 C.

inputLeakage.note: chip, not board. Table 5-3 (p. 52) IIH / IIL max 50 nA, 3.3 V, 25 C.

notes: Board schematic: DOIT "ESP32 DevKit V1" schematic (title block ESP12E, 2014-04-13), https://mischianti.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/DOIT-ESP32-DevKit-V1-schematics.pdf. Power: USB VCC (VCCUSB) through D1 SS14 to VIN; U1 NCP1117 from VIN to VDD3V3 (C1 10 uF in, C2 100 nF + C3 10 uF out); C4 100 uF/6.3 V on the module 3V3.

Regulator: the schematic names NCP1117 without a voltage suffix; the fixed 3.3 V version is inferred from its output net VDD3V3 and its GND pin. Retail DOIT-style boards are often built with an AMS1117-3.3 instead; that is not checked here (no board in hand).
LDO reverse is "body-diode": the NCP1117 datasheet (Protection Diodes, p. 10) describes an internal low-impedance diode path from Vout to Vin.
USB diode reverse is "blocks": D1 is a Schottky from VCCUSB to VIN, so VIN does not back-feed the USB VBUS (apart from its reverse leakage, max 0.2 mA at 25 C, Vishay SS14 p. 2).
Module: the schematic draws U3 as a 38-pin ESP32 module (3V3 pin 2, GND 1/15/38, flash pins 17-22), i.e. an ESP-WROOM-32 footprint; minVolts uses the ESP32-WROOM-32 datasheet.
GPIO pins: every header GPIO (D*, TX0/RX0, TX2/RX2, VP, VN). VP (GPIO36), VN (GPIO39), D34, D35 are input-only, so they carry no current limit. Not listed: EN, power, ground, USB.

Board parts on GPIO pins that this format cannot hold: blue LED + R15 1 kohm on GPIO2 (D2) to GND; R6 10 kohm GPIO2 to GND; R11 10 kohm GPIO5 (D5) to 3V3; R10 10 kohm TX0 to 3V3; TX0/RX0 tied to the CP2102 through R2/R3 1 kohm; R5 10 kohm GPIO0 to 3V3 (GPIO0 is not on the header); R4 10 kohm EN to 3V3.
Per-pin current limits use the datasheet drive figures (IOH/IOL), the only per-pin current numbers Espressif gives; they are rated drive, not absolute maximum.
unaccounted: CP2102 USB-UART bridge (U2), powered from VDD3V3 (VDD and REGIN tied to 3V3 on the schematic): no idle current on the schematic and no measurement.

Red power LED + R14 1 kohm from VDD3V3 to GND: the schematic gives the resistor, not the current (roughly (3.3 V - LED Vf) / 1 kohm, about 1 to 1.5 mA for a red LED Vf of 1.8 to 2.2 V, LED part unknown).
Module extras beyond the chip (SPI flash, crystal): the draw values are the chip's.

disputed.why: The 20 V is correct for the NCP1117 (Maximum Ratings p. 2), but it is a regulator rating applied to the board pin: the schematic gives C1 (VIN input cap) as 10 uF with no voltage rating, and the patch notes say retail DOIT-style boards often carry an AMS1117-3.3 (15 V absolute maximum, AMS1117 datasheet p. 2). The controller may want an estimate of 12 to 15 V with both readings in the note. Not changed: the reading itself checks out against the cited source.

corrected.why: The board carries an ESP32-WROOM-32 module (schematic), and its own datasheet (v3.8, Table 12 Absolute Maximum Ratings, p. 26) gives cumulative IO output current max 1,100 mA, below the bare chip's 1,200 mA; the part on the board takes precedence. Source and note changed to the module datasheet.

The 15 V used is the AMS1117 reading (Absolute Maximum Ratings, Input Voltage 15 V, p. 2), so the source must be the AMS1117 datasheet; the NCP1117 20 V reading (onsemi NCP1117/D Rev. 28, Maximum Ratings p. 2) stays in the note with its URL.
